info.description: Everything this computer can do by itself, the same calls on every computer: run commands, read, write, edit and search files, send web requests, keep text, and, where it has a screen, see and use its windows, mouse and keyboard. /onsay takes prompts from anyone with its prompt key, each answered by Onsay, and its calls answer this account's own devices and anyone with that key.

settings.name: token
settings.title: Sign in
settings.about: This computer's sign in to Onsay, kept by onsay-core <settings> call onsay.sign_in or by the Onsay app.

settings.name: prompt_key
settings.title: Prompt key
settings.about: What a program sends as Authorization: Bearer <prompt key> to prompt this computer at /onsay. Made on its first start.

settings.name: search_calls
settings.title: Find another way
settings.about: true: a call this computer hasn't got, or one that fails, is asked of Onsay's lingo search, which finds a way and gives back its answer. Offline, or when it finds none, it is the error it always was. On unless set to false.

settings.name: headless
settings.title: Work in the background
settings.about: true: clicks and typing go to apps in the background, nothing on screen moves and no window comes to the front. An app that won't take that is brought forward for that one action. On unless set to false. Set with input.modes.

settings.name: no_follow
settings.title: Hide where he clicks
settings.about: true: no pointer or ring goes to where he clicks or types, and the chat stays open. On unless set to false. Set with input.modes.
